cues.zh: 阿姆斯特丹有很多杂货店，真的超多。这里有一家，那里又有一家，

cues.zh: 万一你刚刚没注意到，那边其实也有一家

cues.en: Grocery stores markets butchers and bakers are woven into the urban fabric so that no matter where you are
cues.zh: 杂货店、菜市场、肉铺和面包房深深融入了城市肌理，所以无论你身在何处

cues.en: You're only a short walk to somewhere where you can buy fresh food
cues.zh: 走几步路就能买到新鲜的食材

cues.en: In the Netherlands most people prefer to make small trips to buy food for today or the next few days rather than large weekly
cues.zh: 在荷兰，大多数人更喜欢按一两天的需求少量采购，而不是每周

cues.en: or fortnightly shopping trips by car. This by itself isn't that unusual. Most cities
cues.zh: 或每两周开车大采购一次。这本身倒不算很稀奇。

cues.en: I've been to in Europe and Asia have grocery stores and markets dotted throughout the city.
cues.zh: 我去过的多数欧洲和亚洲城市，街头巷尾也到处都是杂货店和市场。

cues.en: What's interesting about the Netherlands is how optimized everything is to make your
cues.zh: 但荷兰的特别之处在于，这里的一切都经过极致优化，

cues.en: grocery shopping trip as fast as possible. Shops are not set back behind a sea of parking,
cues.zh: 让你买菜能有多快就有多快。商店门口不会隔着一片巨大的停车场，

cues.en: so it's easy to stop in if you're walking by. In fact, many grocery stores do not have any car
cues.zh: 路过时顺脚就能进去。事实上，许多杂货店根本就不提供汽车停车位，

cues.en: parking at all, and it's common to see them in pedestrianized areas accessible only by walking
cues.zh: 而且它们常常开在步行街里，只能步行

cues.en: or cycling.
cues.zh: 或骑车前往。

cues.en: Of course, bicycle parking is always provided right out front, making it also very quick
cues.zh: 当然，门口总是有自行车停放处，所以骑车来买东西

cues.en: to shop by bicycle.
cues.zh: 也非常快捷。

cues.en: Just pull up and lock the bike.
cues.zh: 直接骑过来锁好车。

cues.en: Grab some reusable shopping bags and get a basket.
cues.zh: 拿几个环保购物袋，再提个购物篮。

cues.en: Some of the more modern shops provide hand scanners that allow you to scan your items
cues.zh: 一些比较现代的超市会提供手持扫描枪，让你边逛

cues.en: as you shop.
cues.zh: 边扫商品。

cues.en: Scanning each item as you place it in your bag also means you don't need to re-bag
cues.zh: 把每件商品装进袋子时顺手一扫，也意味着结账时

cues.en: your groceries at the checkout.
cues.zh: 不用再重新装袋了。

cues.en: Since everything has already been scanned, the checkout process is very quick.
cues.zh: 因为所有东西都已经扫过了，结账过程非常快。

cues.en: Just tap your contactless payment card and grab your receipt.
cues.zh: 只需刷一下感应式付款卡，拿上小票。

cues.en: The exit gate opens when you scan your receipt.
cues.zh: 扫一下小票，出口闸门就会打开。

cues.en: Drop the bags back into the bike,
cues.zh: 把袋子放回自行车上，

cues.en: unlock,
cues.zh: 开锁，

cues.en: and we're off.
cues.zh: 我们就可以出发了。

cues.en: For a typical grocery trip I can be in and out in less than 10 minutes,
cues.zh: 平时买点生活用品，我不到 10 分钟就能搞定，

cues.en: and it's easy to do whenever I'm on my way home.
cues.zh: 顺路回家时随时都能顺便去买一下。

cues.en: If you'd rather not buy plastic wrap foods and only interact with machines,
cues.zh: 如果你不想买塑料包装的食品，也不想只跟机器打交道，

cues.en: there are markets available too.
cues.zh: 也有菜市场可以去。

cues.en: Often these have better prices, especially on fresh produce.
cues.zh: 那里的价格通常更划算，尤其是新鲜果蔬。

cues.en: And if you'd prefer to have your vegetables hand polished and looking like a magazine shoot,
cues.zh: 如果你想要那种手工擦得锃亮、像拍杂志一样的蔬菜，

cues.en: you can visit shops the Dutch like to call vegetable jewellers, that is, if you can afford them.
cues.zh: 你可以去逛逛荷兰人戏称为“蔬菜珠宝店”的商铺，当然，前提是你兜里预算够多。

cues.en: It's honestly refreshing to live somewhere where grocery shopping isn't some big ordeal.
cues.zh: 说实话，生活在一个买菜不用大费周章的地方，真的让人神清气爽。

cues.en: In Canada or in the US, I would literally spend more time just waiting at traffic lights
cues.zh: 在加拿大或美国，我光是去超市路上等红绿灯的时间，

cues.en: on the way to the grocery store than my entire trip to the grocery store here in the Netherlands.
cues.zh: 甚至都比我在荷兰去一趟超市全程花的时间还要长。

cues.en: I always found the North American car-centric grocery trip to be really messed up, driving
cues.zh: 我一直觉得北美那种以汽车为中心的买菜方式简直离谱：

cues.en: out to the edge of town in heavy traffic, waiting in huge checkout lines, buying everything
cues.zh: 顶着大堵车一路开到城郊，排着漫长的结账队伍，

cues.en: in massive quantities, effectively turning your house into a convenience store just to
cues.zh: 疯狂囤积大包装商品，硬生生把自家搞得像个便利店，

cues.en: save a few bucks.
cues.zh: 就为了省那么几块钱。

cues.en: And who eats this much food?
cues.zh: 谁能吃得下这么多食物？

cues.en: The truth is, nobody does.
cues.zh: 事实是，根本没人吃得完。

cues.en: The US and Canada have the highest level of food waste in the world.
cues.zh: 美国和加拿大是世界上食物浪费最严重的地区。

cues.en: Almost one quarter of all food purchased by consumers goes to waste, and the bulk shopping
cues.zh: 消费者购买的食物中有将近四分之一都被浪费了，而这种批量采购的

cues.en: culture definitely plays a part in that. You're much less likely to eat fresh
cues.zh: 文化绝对是原因之一。如果你一次性囤上一周的量，

cues.en: food if you're buying it in bulk for the week, rather than if you stop on your
cues.zh: 比起下班顺路买新鲜的，

cues.en: way home from work. Of course, when everyone is forced to travel everywhere
cues.zh: 你吃到新鲜食物的几率要低得多。当然，如果人人都被迫

cues.en: by car, nothing is a quick trip anymore, especially in rush hour. There have been
cues.zh: 开车出行，那就根本不存在所谓的顺路快办了，尤其是在晚高峰。我们一家

cues.en: several times where our family has lived without a car in various cities
cues.zh: 曾有好几次在世界各地的不同城市里过着没有车的生活。

cues.en: around the world. When you tell this to someone in North America, often the
cues.zh: 当你把这事告诉北美的居民时，他们通常

cues.en: first question they ask will be, but how do you buy groceries? I like buying
cues.zh: 第一个问题就会问：那你怎么买菜呢？我喜欢

cues.en: groceries in small quantities. It allows us to eat whatever we're in the mood
cues.zh: 少量多次地采购。这样我们当天想吃什么

cues.en: for that day and with two boys who eat a lot it's good that unexpected grocery trips are quick.
cues.zh: 就能吃什么，而且家里有两个特能吃的小男孩，临时出门买个菜能速战速决就太好了。

cues.en: Small grocery trips make it easier for our family to eat healthy fresh food and we're less likely
cues.zh: 少买勤买让我们家更容易吃上健康新鲜的食物，

cues.en: to have food that goes to waste. It's nice to live in Amsterdam where quick grocery trips are
cues.zh: 也更不容易浪费食物。住在阿姆斯特丹很惬意，在这里随时顺路去趟超市

cues.en: not just possible they're actively encouraged and nobody ever asks us but how do you buy groceries?
cues.zh: 不仅可行，而且非常普遍，从来没人会问我们“你们怎么买菜啊？”
